### Checklist

- [ ] The metadata filename ends in `_META.csv`.

- [ ] Both files use the same new cohort number in `manifest.csv`.
- [ ] I ran `Rscript scripts/validate_hub_data.R .` successfully.
- [ ] The files contain no participant-level or confidential data.
